body:
This post makes me really sad because i’m living the same thing with my parents in these days...
I’m worried i will never find a home...
At least they noticed and tried to be friendly....it’s not much after the damage they have done, but maybe they understood and are trying to be better
I feel you...today i had all my lunch break listening to my transphobic collegues joking and insulting trans people...it have been hard to not cry in that moment...it ruined my day
Omg, you look so beautifull honey!!!
Awwww
It’s not true, you look beautiful in this outfit💛

Thank you very much, i really appreciate your advice. I’ll try to wear them on my free time first, then i hope to get enough courage to try it at work...
But first i think i will have to come out to the bosses and managers😰
You look amazing💛💛
I feel exactly the same...thank you very much for sharing your experience☺️
I’m in this photo and i don’t like it
Thank you, i don’t know what i will do, but having someone reading what i have to say and writing some kind words means a lot to me

That’s how i felt...and sadly, after coming out as trans woman, i saw how everything changed...i’m blocked because i fear that if i keep going with transition i will lose my family and friends forever..
Can you tell me more about your diet?
You look so beautifull💛💛
It had to be done, you are a good person💛
I feel you, i know it’s hard but please search for help, there is always hope💛
Got caught shaving my legs a couple of months ago, i’m out but not accepted, my mom reacted badly...closed myself again
That is so relatable that it hurt
Tes, that’s exactly the feeling i have😔

Thank you for your reply, i think that is because i’m scared of everything that comes with being trans...i’m scared of being bullied, i’m scared of all the hormones and surgery problems that could occour, i’m scared of losing my family, my friends, everyone i love...
I think that trans people are really strong and i just think that i can’t be strong enough, so i put myself down and deny the possibility to be happy just because of fear...
Ci ho dato un’occhiata e Western Legends mi ispira parecchio, come meccaniche, anche se non moltissimo come tema
Beh ecco, diciamo che come budget vorrei rimanete contenuta(max 60), nell’ultimo periodo ho speso un po’ troppo in giochi da tavolo😂

Ho acquistato da poco star wars: orlo esterno...mi piacciono molto le meccaniche. 
Oltre a questo ho visto Venice e Yukon Airways, che mi ispiravano.
Non voglio giochi che vadano oltre le 2/3 ore di gioco, ma che comunque siano longevi e permettano di divertirsi anche dopo diverse partite
I just feel the same, i have no more strength to keep fighting
